editorial:
Imagine being married to a high-powered lawyer who cares more about his career than you. That is exactly where you start with this story. You will meet a wife who feels completely ignored, so she finds comfort in the arms of a man her husband actually put behind bars. It is a risky, tense setup that feels like a juicy soap opera but with a dark, dangerous edge. The vibe is heavy on suspicion and secrets, making you wonder who is actually the villain in this messy love triangle.

What really works here is how the tension builds after the lover is killed. You get to play detective as the wife starts questioning if her husband is a cold-blooded killer. The acting is solid and the pacing keeps you guessing, though some parts feel a bit slow since it was originally a TV movie. If you enjoy old-school mysteries, you should definitely check this out. You can find it by renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend night.
endingExplained: At the end, the truth comes out about the murder. It turns out the husband did find out about the affair and killed the ex-convict in a fit of rage and jealousy. He tried to cover his tracks using his legal knowledge, but his wife eventually finds the proof. The movie wraps up with the husband facing the consequences of his crimes, showing that his ambition and ego finally destroyed his own life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic crime dramas and twisty marriage stories.
